narrator.instruct: Fast, dry, witty female narrator teasing a friend. Brisk, punchy delivery with no pauses between sentences.

sofia.instruct: Loud, glamorous, theatrical young woman who loves attention, fast and dramatic.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Your Leo friend wore gold sequins to your wedding. Sofia is not the bride. You are.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That's Sofia. Generous, loud and always glowing.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She brought her own ring light to the ceremony.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: During the vows she fixed her hair in a trumpet.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then she gives the toast and it's mostly about her.

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: And that's how the bride met her best friend. Me!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The crowd loves it. Sofia is winning.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Then the lights go down for the first dance.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One spotlight comes on. It lands on the bride.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Sofia stands in the dark for the first time ever.

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Excuse me? Is this thing broken?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So what's going on inside a Leo?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Picture a theater with one switch marked SPOTLIGHT. It only points one way at her.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Backstage an applause meter must stay in the red.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: There's a mirror labelled MAIN and one labelled BACKUP.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And a big heart with a sign that says GENEROUS.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Because Leos love big and they pay for everyone's drinks.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So Sofia walks into the light to dance with the bride.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: She trips on the dress and lands in the cake.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Somehow it's the best photo of the night.
